content: case entity marks the mention of a patient. A case report can contain more than one case description. Therefore, all the findings, factors and conditions related to one patient are linked to the respective case entity. Within the text, this entity is often represented by the first mention of the patient and overlaps with the factor annotations which can, e. g., mark sex and age (cf. Figure FIGREF12).
